units.rawText: Sol's made it here and so did the operands. The Oasis' Sandbox Barrier is back to full efficiency. We're all good here.

units.rawText: The new Turing doesn't know anything about what's going on, so I can't just leave her behind.

units.rawText: I learned something from Miss Persicaria. It seems you are able to erect a barrier than can cover an entire sector, right? That would mean Rossum could also...

units.rawText: It's not a problem. Just that once the Sandbox Barrier goes up, Rossum will be in the same situation as the Oasis, and you will be unable to benefit from the Sanctifiers' protection. Does that not bother you?

units.rawText: What?
units.displayText: What?

units.rawText: Who is this person calling themselves the Professor?
units.displayText: Who is this person calling themselves the Professor?

units.rawText: Antonina, what are you talking about? Isn't this...
units.displayText: Antonina, what are you talking about? Isn't this...

units.displayText: This is not the Professor! Wake up, Persicaria!

units.rawText: Wait, do you think they're not the Professor because they don't look like the Professor...

spans.text: Wait, do you think they're not the Professor because they don't look like the Professor...

units.rawText: Appearances on the cloud server depend on one's neural cloud projection, so humans not looking like they do in reality is perfectly normal. Of course I know that!

, so humans not looking like they do in reality is perfectly normal. Of course I know that!

units.rawText: I also know their Signature and permissions are identical to the Professor's! But that's not the point!
units.displayText: I also know their Signature and permissions are identical to the Professor's! But that's not the point!

spans.text: I also know their Signature and permissions are identical to the Professor's! But that's not the point!

units.rawText: You should not have directed battles before my eyes. The real Professor could never have provided such precise leadership.

units.displayText: ...Persicaria?

units.rawText: You don't know what the Professor... You don't know how much the Professor has done for us.
units.displayText: You don't know what the Professor... You don't know how much the Professor has done for us.

units.displayText: Me, Sol, Croque... The professor saved so many of us Dolls.

units.rawText: ...The Professor gave us Exiles a home...
units.displayText: ...The Professor gave us Exiles a home...

spans.text: ...The Professor gave us Exiles a home...

units.rawText: We don't believe in the Professor because they're the Professor, but because the Professor has done things that merit our faith.
units.displayText: We don't believe in the Professor because they're the Professor, but because the Professor has done things that merit our faith.

units.displayText: Even so...

units.displayText: Even so, the Oasis would not have lasted until today without the Professor.

spans.text: Even so, the Oasis would not have lasted until today without the Professor.

units.rawText: ...By saying all that, it means you won't allow me to doubt them, then?
units.displayText: ...By saying all that, it means you won't allow me to doubt them, then?

spans.text: ...By saying all that, it means you won't allow me to doubt them, then?

units.rawText: ...That's not what I meant. I just want to say that if the Professor truly wanted to hurt us, then why would they have to wait until today?
units.displayText: ...That's not what I meant. I just want to say that if the Professor truly wanted to hurt us, then why would they have to wait until today?

units.rawText: You shouldn't deny the Professor outright just because of a single doubt.
units.displayText: You shouldn't deny the Professor outright just because of a single doubt.

19.name: Permission Key
19.description: The Key with the highest level of clearance and privileges within a sector, usually in the possession on the Sector Adminstrator. Special commands can be issued to the sector with the Key.

47.name: Neural Cloud Projection
47.description:
The visual manifestation of a Doll in Magrasea. Since neural clouds within Magrasea are incorporeal, a Doll's Neural Cloud Projection is determined by their neural data. Depending on the situation, certain clothing, objects, and even pets from the real world can be rendered.
 By collecting neural fragments and completing a Doll's neural cloud, their Neural Cloud Projection can be refined.
